knowledge_misuse: PRD-08296 (short-circuit application note) values are attributed under REF-WS-CGD1700HB2M-UNA; PRD-08296 is not in the knowledge base and is a separate Wolfspeed document (Rev. 1, Nov 2023, module CAB016M12FM3 data). Cite it as its own external source or add a reference record.
KR-GD-006 is tagged 'direct' although its applicability condition is multi-supplier sourcing; the same-supplier C4MS/C3M generation fallback is an adaptation.
KR-PR-001 is tagged 'human-review' although it is a hard constraint directly applicable to a product SiC converter; the agent's hand-off treatment is correct, the label is not.

The 0.5 K/W heat-sink resistance is TI's CR201-50VE instance value (SKILL-006 / EC-019) adopted as a working assumption; it is clearly labelled and handed to the thermal agent, but must not be treated as a design value until the sink is selected.
Dead time 250 ns per edge is described as a 'task default'; it is not in the shared design basis and is an agent assumption.

Positive finding: no reference instance value (2 ohm R_G, 6.4 V / 1 us DESAT, 0.1 K/W pad, 40 degC ambient, PRD-09301 3 ohm / 1.3 ohm example, TI 50/69 W limits) was copied as a design value; the Gen-3-only +19/-8 V limit was correctly replaced by the C4MS datasheet limits.
required_changes: Replace '28 / 37.0 mohm at V_GS = 15 V' with '28 mohm typ at 15 V (no 15 V maximum published; 37 mohm is a scaled estimate)' and note that I_D, I_DM and the 1.88 tempco are specified at V_GS = 18 V.
Renormalise or relabel the 27.5 A efficiency-impact entries: 56.2 W = 1.02 %, 54.9 W = 1.00 %, 53.5 W = 0.97 % of 5500 W (or label the column 'share of 5 kW').

Cite PRD-08296 Rev. 1 (Nov 2023) as its own source; state that the 2.9 us / about 300 ns figures are CAB016M12FM3 module data at 800 V, 175 degC, V_GS 15 V, R_G 4 ohm, that the note's only discrete data point is at 800 V, and that the 9 us / 1.8 us C3M0032120K figures come from the Wolfspeed forum FAQ ID-1 (25 degC, 15 nH).

Remove or source the 'Wolfspeed primer 80-90 %' and 'GE APEC 2015 25 %' attributions; present the 80/90/70 % utilisation limits purely as engineering judgement for human review, optionally citing the Wolfspeed forum guidance of about 900 V maximum bus for 1200 V modules (75 %).

Reword 'No Gen-4 650 V or 750 V family is listed': a Gen-4 750 V class exists at platform level (automotive / module / bare die per Richardson RFPD, Feb 2026); an industrial 750 V TO-247-4 Gen-4 part was neither confirmed nor excluded - check the Wolfspeed 750 V listing.

Correct the C4MS025120K product-page URL to https://www.wolfspeed.com/products/power/sic-mosfets/1200v-c4ms-discrete-silicon-carbide-mosfets/c4ms025120k and keep all stock/price figures marked unverified until procurement confirms.
Relabel KR-GD-006 as 'adapted' and KR-PR-001 as 'direct (hard constraint)'; mark the 0.5 K/W sink as a reference instance value pending the thermal agent's selection.
Correct the dead-time basis to 'agent assumption'; note that V_GS(th) min 2.0 V is a 25 degC value (hot minimum unpublished).

Check whether a newer C3M0021120K datasheet exists (product page dates it 09/2025; fetched file is Rev. 4, June 2025) and capture the unverified fallback sub-values (I_D at 100 degC, 175 degC ratio, hot V_SD).
summary: Primary-source check of the Wolfspeed selection: every quoted parameter of the selected C4MS025120K matches the fetched Rev. 2 (Dec 2025) datasheet and the part is Active; the C4MS018120K (Rev. 1, Jun 2026, Active/New), C3M0021120K fallback (Active), C3M0015065K alternative (Active) and C3M0032120K values match their datasheets; C3M0030090K is Obsolete with the named replacements C3M0032120K/C4MS036120K and C3M0065090J is NRND in TO-263-7, as stated. PRD-08296 confirms 2.9 us at 800 V / 175 degC and about 300 ns DESAT turn-off (module data), and the forum FAQ confirms 9 us / 1.8 us for C3M0032120K. All knowledge-base citations were read correctly and no reference instance value was copied as a design value. Corrections: a derived 37 mohm 'max' presented beside datasheet values, 27.5 A efficiency percentages normalised to 5 kW instead of 5.5 kW, mis-attribution of PRD-08296 to the CGD1700 reference, unverifiable '80-90 % primer' and 'GE 25 %' derating snippets, an unverified claim that no Gen-4 family exists below 1200 V, unverified distributor stock, and minor applicability labels (KR-GD-006, KR-PR-001) and the dead-time basis. None of the corrections changes the 1200 V class decision or the C4MS025120K selection.
